Animated Armour is a Construct in Baldur's Gate 3. They are in the Arcane Tower, Grymforge, and Sorcerous Sundries. Animated Armour can be disabled by anti-magic effects.
“
Suits of magically animated plate armour. Ponderous and persistent, these constructs are often used as guardians.
„
— In-game racial description

Involvement

Act One

Four (or six, on Tactician difficulty and above) animated armours armed with crossbows are on the top floor of the Arcane Tower with  Bernard. Several more defend Grymforge.

Act Two

A unique animated armour, the  Hollow Armour, is located in the pit of the House of Healing Morgue.

Act Three

Sorcerous Sundries employs several animated armours as guards, some of whom take part in the fight with  Lorroakan.

Combat

Animated armours are equipped with basic weapons, usually a  Greatsword or  Heavy Crossbow.

Animated armours can be disabled by  Sussur Antimagic Field from  Sussar Blooms. This works either when the Sussur Bloom is placed near them or held by a nearby character. The number of flowers in the Underdark is enough to disable all animated armours when fighting Bernard.

Due to their low Wisdom, animated armours are susceptible to spells or effects targeting a Wisdom saving throws, such as  Command However, animated armours are immune to many mental effects like  Frightened,  Hold Person, and  Crown of Madness.

Their weight is low at 40 kg / 80 lb. A character with a minimum of 15 strength can attempt to pick up and throw them with the  Throw action. In the Arcane Tower and Grymforge encounters, they can be thrown into the surrounding chasms to instantly destroy them.
